title: AgentConfig (draft v0, proposed by the backend, not yet confirmed by the AI engine owner)
description: SUPERSEDED (2026-10-28, Phase 5B-1; re-checked 2026-10-29, Phase 5B-3): the settings document the backend stores and serves is the engine's own shape, see AgentConfig in backend-internal.openapi.yaml and team-alignment L7 and E1; this chat-era file is kept as history only and is NOT implemented, and it is deliberately NOT updated to the live document. The live document, since Phase 5B-3, adds the engine's optional fields greeting, recordCalls, autoEndCalls, endCallDelaySeconds, profileSummary, profileSummarySources and escalation.announce, and keeps any key it does not know exactly as sent (the engine owns the field list). Original note: ON HOLD (2026-10-21): this draft assumed the backend owns the agent configuration and covers chat and actions. Abdullah's engine keeps its own settings (business name, purpose, tone, timezone, hours, escalation, capabilities, voices and a "what the agent collects" checklist) and the ownership question (team-alignment M, Q21) is open; do not implement this schema until it is decided. The per-tenant configuration of the AI agent (team-alignment E1). The backend stores it versioned in tenant_core.agent_configs and serves the latest version to the engine at GET /internal/tenants/{tenantId}/agent-config. Owners and admins edit it from the dashboard; agents can read it. The engine must treat every free-text field as untrusted input to the model (it is typed by a tenant user), and must validate action parameters in code, not trust the model (E4). `version`, `updatedAt` and `updatedBy` are set by the backend and ignored on save.

version.description: Set by the backend; every save creates a new version.

updatedBy.description: Staff user id, null for system changes.

name.description: The name the agent uses for itself.

instructions.description: Free-text guidance from the tenant. Untrusted: never allowed to override platform rules, tenant isolation or action limits.

languages.description: Languages the agent may answer in (BCP-47). Must be a subset of what the engine can really answer in; today en and ur. Not the same list as the dashboard languages.

fallbackMessage.description: Shown to the customer when the AI cannot answer (engine down, tenant blocked). The widget falls back to the platform's own translated text when a language is missing.

handoffMessage.description: Shown when the conversation is passed to a human.

failedAttempts.description: Escalate after this many answers the customer did not accept.

outsideHours.description: Escalate (or queue) outside the working hours below.

timezone.description: IANA name; defaults to the tenant's timezone (J7, default Asia/Karachi).

limitMinor.description: Amount limit in minor units of PKR (null = no amount concept for this kind). Above it the action stops at `proposed` and needs an owner or admin.

retentionDays.description: How long the engine keeps messages, recordings and logs of this tenant (F1). Independent of the 60-day rules after a plan ends (I10).

localizedText.description: Text per language code. Must contain the defaultLanguage; other keys must be in `languages`.

to.description: Must be later than `from` on the same day (no overnight ranges in v0).
